subject.title: feat(plugins): tool-name matchers scope tool hooks and Codex native hook relay spawns

question: Should exact tool-name matching become a supported public contract across plugin hooks, trusted tool policies, and agent tool-result middleware?
rationale: This adds compatibility-sensitive behavior to three plugin registration surfaces, and only maintainers can confirm the permanent alias, empty-list, repeated-registration, and per-runtime semantics.

options.title: Approve after contract repairs
options.body: Accept the public matcher direction after canonical alias handling, per-runtime scope preservation, compatibility tests, and live Codex proof are added.

options.title: Keep scoping Codex-internal
options.body: Avoid expanding the public plugin API and instead pursue an internal Codex relay optimization until broader plugin matcher semantics are designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after contract repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the public matcher direction after canonical alias handling, per-runtime scope preservation, compatibility tests, and live Codex proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to the native relay lifecycle and fail-closed behavior affected by the API decision.
